BT-UI-001.description: To-Do is gone; Background Tasks sits above Activity, collapsed; expanded it reads the run and shows 0 counts; Activity expanded by default (AC-001, AC-002)

BT-UI-002.description: A running task appears live with description, kind and status without changing run status (AC-007)

BT-UI-003.description: Newest first; finishing one task changes only that entry; long text stays inside the panel (AC-008, AC-012)

BT-UI-004.description: Summary expands by click and keyboard and collapses again

BT-UI-005.description: Tasks are per run: another run shows only its own tasks, and the first run its own again (AC-009 web side)

BT-UI-006.description: Accordion: expanding Activity collapses Background Tasks; a narrow (320px, drawer-like) right panel keeps a one-line header and rows inside the panel

BT-UI-007.description: Shell command line: filled in by a follow-up snapshot, one truncated monospace line with tooltip, click/keyboard expand, no repeat of an AGY title (ticket background-task-shell-command AC-001, AC-003, AC-004, AC-005)

style.fontFamily: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", "Courier New", monospace

BT-UI-008.description: Why a task ended: one line under each ended task, status chips unchanged, the summary kept (autobyteus-483 REQ-004, AC-005..AC-008)

endLines: Stopped: it reached its time limit — not a failure of the command
Stopped: the computer was low on memory

BT-UI-009.description: A polled (snapshot) run shows its exit code line; an unsupported run says inspection is unavailable (autobyteus-473 answers)

BT-UI-010.description: No run selected: a plain message instead of checking forever, no counts (autobyteus-483 REQ-005, AC-009)
